dedupe_keys.name: pavement thru lane pavement shoulder pavement other lane

description: Pierce County, Washington publishes linked GIS-Mo layers for through lanes, shoulders and other dedicated road lanes. Coverage is county road segments described by the County Road Administration Board GIS-Mo database. The three native layers share the StateLRS route reference, begin/end measures, AssetType, side-of-road and pavement-history fields, so they are grouped as one pavement resource. Width is labelled in feet and pavement thickness in tenths of an inch. Maintenance, replacement and base construction types and years can support road-asset capacity and intervention planning. The shoulder title and endpoint identify shoulders, while its provider description says other road lanes; that source conflict remains unresolved at individual feature level. These geometry and construction-history layers are distinct from the already catalogued five-column pavement-condition assessment and its aggregate, which classify roads as good, fair or poor. The existing sidewalk layer is also separate. Public ArcGIS metadata and export descriptors provide access routes; no features or files were read. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF which was not opened, and charges are not stated. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present condition or exact observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. Related existing records are identified below.
